data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, even if others choose 10; this is individual, not all-or-nothing. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Assuming k choose 18 and the rest 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled, but costs 8 tons remaining and 16 in the low-recovery outcome. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. This needn't maximize long-run income.
